ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a macro ratio of approximately 90:10 against high-intensity (white) pixels localized at lobe margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions consist of a solid low-intensity mask. High-intensity pixels are mapped as contiguous horizontal bands along the upper distal margins of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp interior angle (~45 degrees) and high bounding-box depth relative to the overall fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing boundary. Irregular protrusions are present at the distal tips where barnacle colonization disrupts the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex sweep along the leading edges, transitioning to a sharp upward taper at the outer lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of scattered circular white-on-black ring-like pixel clusters (2D diameters ranging approximately 5-20 pixels) distributed across the dark ventral surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of sessile barnacles visible as high-relief, high-intensity bumpy protrusions concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and at the central peduncle insertion point.
